pew-elon-imagining-2005-001.note: Wikipedia Metcalf sniper attack confirms 17 transformers, >$15M, power rerouted, only local brief outages; no devastating US infrastructure/grid attack 2005-2014, so 'agree' view is a miss.

pew-elon-imagining-2005-002.note: Wikipedia Stingray phone tracker (42 agencies in 17 states by 2014, $71M DOJ 2010-14, Florida 200+ uses) and US v. Jones (arrest on GPS, conviction on cell-site data) support routine device-surveillance-based arrests by 2014; hit.

pew-elon-imagining-2005-003.note: NCES 2012-008 reports 1,816,400 K-12 distance course enrollments in 2009-10 (<4% of ~49M students); NCES Fast Facts id=79: 21% of schools offered any fully online course in 2017-18. Far from 'most students'; miss.

pew-elon-imagining-2005-005.note: Wikipedia YouTube: 48 h/min uploads and 3B daily views in 2011, 100 h/min 2013, 300 h/min Nov 2014; independent creative work circulated freely at mass scale; hit.

pew-elon-imagining-2005-006.note: Wikipedia Cord-cutting: 84.7% pay-TV in 2012, first decline 2013, cord-cutters majority only 2022; streaming large but TV not displaced and not 'all media' by 2014, so partial holds. Grader A's claim that streaming reached mainstream only 2017+ is wrong (internet-only households is the wrong test) but does not change the verdict; B's Netflix traffic row was not confirmed by the fetched page.

pew-elon-imagining-2005-007.note: Pew internet/broadband fact sheet: home broadband 70% of US adults in 2013, 67% in 2015. (90-70)/70 = 29%, outside the D16 25% partial band; miss.

pew-elon-imagining-2005-008.note: Wikipedia BitTorrent: 150M active users 2012, 15-27M concurrent 2013, 200,000+ US suits since 2010 did not stop sharing; easy P2P copying still available in 2014 ('anonymous' overstated, IPs visible). Hit.

pew-elon-imagining-2005-010.note: BLS Volunteering 2014 (archive release 2015-02-25): 25.3% in 2014, down from 26.8% in 2011; BLS 2015 release: 24.9%. No substantial rise in civic involvement; miss. The 28.8% 2005 peak both graders cite is not on the cited pages, but the decline is.

pew-elon-imagining-2005-011.note: Health System Tracker (KFF/Peterson): per-capita spending rose continuously, GDP share ~16-17% through 2005-2014, 18.0% in 2024; no substantial improvement in costs from online resources; miss.

pew-elon-imagining-2005-014.note: Wikipedia 2014 US elections (turnout 36.4%, lowest since 1942) and Electronic voting in the US (online return limited to UOCAVA and a few disability/emergency cases; security flaws in every attempt). Majority 'disagree' held; hit.

pew-elon-imagining-2006-001.note: ITU Facts and Figures 2020: >90% under 3G+ in most regions, but about a quarter of LDC/LLDC population without mobile broadband, SDG 9.c universal affordable access missed, mobile broadband 'remains too expensive for many'. Coverage held, 'anyone anywhere at extremely low cost' did not; partial.

pew-elon-imagining-2006-002.note: Wikipedia Languages used on the Internet: English 25.9% of users vs Chinese 19.4% (2020); English online grew 281% vs Chinese 1,277%, Russian 1,826% (2001-11). No English displacement via the internet; majority 'disagree' held. Measure is indirect but points one way.

pew-elon-imagining-2006-005.note: Wikipedia Quest 2: at least 10M shipped by Nov 2021, the market leader; VR far below 5% of users for work by 2025, no widespread VR addiction; miss with window closed.

pew-elon-imagining-2006-006.note: Freedom on the Net 2020: 10th consecutive year of decline, race to 'cyber sovereignty', data localisation in Brazil, Nigeria, Turkey; national boundaries strengthened online, not replaced; miss.

pew-elon-imagining-2006-007.note: Wikipedia 5G misinformation: ~90 UK mast attacks, ~50 assaults on engineers, Dutch sabotage and 7 Canadian towers destroyed in 2020 (anti-technology violence), but no measurable self-segregating refusenik culture; partial.

pew-elon-imagining-2008-002.note: Wikipedia Hate crimes in the US: 'after a slow decline, the number of hate crimes increased since the mid 2010s' (~7,100 in 2013 to 8,646 in 2018); DOJ hate crime statistics: 11,679 incidents in 2024. No tolerance gain in the named metric; majority 'disagree' held. Grader A's '~8,200 in 2020, highest since 2008' is not on the cited pages.

pew-elon-imagining-2008-003.note: Wikipedia Copyright Alert System: warnings and throttling 2013-2017, no billing, no reporting to authorities, ended Jan 2017 for not reducing piracy. No such regime in 2020; majority 'disagree' held.

pew-elon-imagining-2008-004.note: Pew 2021 social media use (72% of adults) and DataReportal 2020 (3.80B users) show far more sharing; Pew 2019 privacy survey (79% concerned, 81% little control, 81% risks outweigh benefits) shows privacy norms did not loosen; forgiveness unmeasured. Partial.

pew-elon-imagining-2008-005.note: Wikipedia Pokemon Go (147M MAU May 2018, MAU +45% Jan-Aug 2020) and Second Life (800-900k users end 2017, IBM left): AR measurable and large, virtual worlds niche, no required metaverse presence; partial. Grader A's eMarketer citation returns HTTP 403 and could not be checked.

pew-elon-imagining-2008-006.note: Pew 2017: 46% of US adults use voice assistants (42% on phones), so public dictation mainstream; Wikipedia Projection keyboard shows no mass adoption, air-typing not common. Half the scenario held; partial.

pew-elon-imagining-2008-007.note: Wikipedia IPv6 deployment: IETF expects IPv6 to coexist with IPv4 via dual-stack/tunnelling/translation; the TCP/IP architecture was refined, not replaced, by 2020; hit.

pew-elon-imagining-2010-02-004.note: Freedom on the Net 2019 (9th year of decline, arrests for speech in record 47 of 65 countries) and 2020 (10th year), plus Wikipedia net neutrality repeal effective 11 June 2018: disputes went toward restriction while the TCP/IP core stayed end-to-end; partial. Borderline toward miss, since the restriction clause is the substance of the tension pair.

pew-elon-imagining-2010-02-005.note: Wikipedia Tor: ~4M users Nov 2013, described as easy to use, on Windows/macOS/Linux/Android; pseudonymous posting remained standard and no general biometric ID gateway existed in 2020; majority 'disagree' (option B) held; hit.

pew-elon-imagining-2010-05-001.note: Wikipedia Semantic Web: vision 'remains largely unrealized', ~4M of ~250M domains with markup in 2013, partial progress only via schema.org/knowledge graphs; the pessimistic majority view held; hit.

pew-elon-imagining-2010-06-001.note: Wikipedia PC vendor market share: shipments 262.6M (2019), 275M (2020), 339.8M (2021); DataReportal 2020: mobile 53% of web requests but three-quarters of 16-64 users still on laptops/desktops. Cloud and mobile apps mainstream, PC not displaced for work; partial.

pew-elon-imagining-2010-07-002.note: Pew Social media use in 2021: 84% of 18-29 and 81% of 30-49 use social media; aging millennials kept sharing; hit. Grader B's fact-sheet row now shows 2025 data (30-49: Facebook 80%, Instagram 62%), not the 2021 figures quoted, but it supports the same state.

pew-elon-imagining-2012-03-001.note: comScore 2016: smartphone apps over half of US digital media time; comScore Nov 2020: 79% of US digital minutes on mobile; eMarketer via Digital Information World: 88% of mobile time in apps in 2020. Apps, not the open web, dominate; miss.

pew-elon-imagining-2012-05-001.note: Pew 2020: 21% of US adults regularly use a smartwatch/fitness tracker (2019); Wikipedia Duolingo: ~30M active users Dec 2019 with streaks, XP, leagues, badges. Gamification in everyday use for many; majority option B held; hit. Tracker share is a proxy for gamification, the weakest link.

pew-elon-imagining-2012-06-001.note: Parks Associates (PR Newswire): 13% of US broadband households owned a smart thermostat in Feb 2020, 16% in Feb 2023; EIA: utility smart meters 72% of meters in 2022. Measurable household resource management above 5%, below 20%; partial.

pew-elon-imagining-2012-07-001.note: Wikipedia Sandvine: equipment used for Belarus 2020 protest shutdowns and Egyptian censorship; first US penalty (Entity List) only Feb 2024, lifted Oct 2024. No norm with significant penalties in 2020; miss.

pew-elon-imagining-2012-07-003.note: NCES Fast Facts id=80: undergraduates in any distance course 36% fall 2019, 75% fall 2020 (postbacc 42%, 71%); higher education was quite different in 2020 and the 'little change' option failed; hit. Customised graduation requirements did not arrive, an unweighted clause.

pew-elon-imagining-2014-05-001.note: IoT Analytics: 18.5B connected IoT devices in 2024, 21.1B expected end 2025; Parks Associates: 34% of US broadband households own a smart-home device (2021). Widespread everyday presence held; 'beneficial' left ungraded as a value word; hit.

pew-elon-imagining-2014-07-001.note: Freedom on the Net 2024: 14th consecutive year of decline, blocking of political/social/religious content in 41+ countries, arrests for expression in 56 of 72. Significant changes for the worse occurred, so the majority 'no' is a miss.

pew-elon-imagining-2014-08-001.note: BLS chart confirms US unemployment 4.0-4.4% Jan-Sep 2025, but aggregate unemployment does not measure jobs displaced vs created by AI and robots; no public series measures that balance, so the evidence is a proxy of another quantity (D22/D23) and supports neither hit nor miss.

pew-elon-imagining-2014-12-001.note: Pew 2023 How Americans view data privacy: 73% little/no control over company data, 67% understand little, 71% doubt tech-leader accountability, 72% want more regulation. No popularly accepted trusted privacy infrastructure by 2025; majority 'no' held; hit.
